options.name: applianceIp
options.description: The local IP of the appliance on the VLAN.

options.name: cidr
options.description: CIDR of the pool of subnets. Applicable only for template network. Each network bound to the template will automatically pick a subnet from this pool to build its own VLAN.

options.name: dhcpBootFilename
options.description: DHCP boot option for boot filename.

options.name: dhcpBootNextServer
options.description: DHCP boot option to direct boot clients to the server to load the boot file from.

options.name: dhcpBootOptionsEnabled
options.description: Use DHCP boot options specified in other properties.

options.name: dhcpHandling
options.description: The appliance's handling of DHCP requests on this VLAN. One of 'Run a DHCP server', 'Relay DHCP to another server' or 'Do not respond to DHCP requests'.

options.name: dhcpLeaseTime
options.description: The term of DHCP leases if the appliance is running a DHCP server on this VLAN. One of '30 minutes', '1 hour', '4 hours', '12 hours', '1 day' or '1 week'.

options.name: dhcpOptions
options.description: The list of DHCP options that will be included in DHCP responses. Each object in the list should have "code", "type", and "value" properties.

options.name: dhcpRelayServerIps
options.description: The IPs (IPv4) of the DHCP servers that DHCP requests should be relayed to. CIDR/subnet notation and hostnames are not supported.

options.name: dnsNameservers
options.description: The DNS nameservers used for DHCP responses, either "upstream_dns", "google_dns", "opendns", or a newline seperated string of IP addresses or domain names.

options.name: fixedIpAssignments
options.description: The DHCP fixed IP assignments on the VLAN. This should be an object that contains mappings from MAC addresses to objects that themselves each contain "ip" and "name" string fields. See the sample request/response for more details.

options.name: groupPolicyId
options.description: The id of the desired group policy to apply to the VLAN.

options.name: id
options.description: The VLAN ID of the new VLAN (must be between 1 and 4094).

options.name: ipv6
options.description: IPv6 configuration on the VLAN.

options.name: mandatoryDhcp
options.description: Mandatory DHCP will enforce that clients connecting to this VLAN must use the IP address assigned by the DHCP server. Clients who use a static IP address won't be able to associate. Only available on firmware versions 17.0 and above.

options.name: mask
options.description: Mask used for the subnet of all bound to the template networks. Applicable only for template network.

options.name: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time
options.displayName: Meraki Action Batch Retry Wait Time
options.description: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time (integer), action batch concurrency error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_api_key
options.description: meraki_api_key (string), API key generated in dashboard; can also be set as an environment variable MERAKI_DASHBOARD_API_KEY

options.name: meraki_base_url
options.description: meraki_base_url (string), preceding all endpoint resources

options.name: meraki_be_geo_id
options.description: meraki_be_geo_id (string), optional partner identifier for API usage tracking; can also be set as an environment variable BE_GEO_ID

options.name: meraki_certificate_path
options.description: meraki_certificate_path (string), path for TLS/SSL certificate verification if behind local proxy

options.name: meraki_inherit_logging_config
options.description: meraki_inherit_logging_config (boolean), Inherits your own logger instance

options.name: meraki_log_file_prefix
options.description: meraki_log_file_prefix (string), log file name appended with date and timestamp

options.name: meraki_log_path
options.description: log_path (string), path to output log; by default, working directory of script if not specified

options.name: meraki_maximum_retries
options.description: meraki_maximum_retries (integer), retry up to this many times when encountering 429s or other server-side errors

options.name: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time
options.description: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time (integer), Nginx 429 retry wait time

options.name: meraki_output_log
options.description: meraki_output_log (boolean), create an output log file?

options.name: meraki_print_console
options.description: meraki_print_console (boolean), print logging output to console?

options.name: meraki_requests_proxy
options.description: meraki_requests_proxy (string), proxy server and port, if needed, for HTTPS

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error (boolean), retry if encountering other 4XX error (besides 429)?

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time (integer), other 4XX error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_simulate
options.description: meraki_simulate (boolean), simulate POST/PUT/DELETE calls to prevent changes?

options.name: meraki_single_request_timeout
options.description: meraki_single_request_timeout (integer), maximum number of seconds for each API call

options.name: meraki_suppress_logging
options.description: meraki_suppress_logging (boolean), disable all logging? you're on your own then!

options.name: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages
options.displayName: Meraki Use Iterator For Get Pages
options.description: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages (boolean), list* methods will return an iterator with each object instead of a complete list with all items

options.name: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit (boolean), retry if 429 rate limit error encountered?

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the new VLAN.

options.name: networkId
options.description: NetworkId path parameter. Network ID.

options.name: reservedIpRanges
options.description: The DHCP reserved IP ranges on the VLAN.

options.name: subnet
options.description: The subnet of the VLAN.

options.name: templateVlanType
options.description: Type of subnetting of the VLAN. Applicable only for template network.

options.name: uplinks
options.description: Per-uplink NAT exception override configuration on the VLAN. Applicable only for networks that support NAT exceptions.

options.name: vlanId
options.description: VlanId path parameter. Vlan ID.

options.name: vpnNatSubnet
options.description: The translated VPN subnet if VPN and VPN subnet translation are enabled on the VLAN.
